seasons.intro.text: A season runs from its first to its last day and has one or two parts, for example August to December and January to June. Seasons do not overlap; the current season is the one that contains today in the group's time zone.

seasons.part2.help.text: Leave every field of part 2 empty for a season with one part.

seasons.alternating.help.text: The weekly plan can differ between A and B weeks. The first week of the part is an A week.

seasons.read_only.text: Admins and managers maintain the seasons.

seasons.delete_confirm.text: Delete this season with its parts and coach assignments? This cannot be undone.

seasons.coaches.help.text: Coaches are assigned on each team's page. Coaches of the current season manage their teams' rosters and invites.

seasons.coaches.no_candidates.text: No member holds the coach role. Give a member the coach role on the members page first.

seasons.error.invalid_name.text: Enter a name up to 64 characters.

seasons.error.name_taken.text: Another season already has this name.

seasons.error.invalid_dates.text: Enter a first day before the last day.

seasons.error.overlap.text: These dates overlap another season. Seasons cannot overlap.

seasons.error.parts.text: A season has one or two parts.

seasons.error.invalid_part_name.text: Enter a part name up to 64 characters.

seasons.error.invalid_part_dates.text: Enter a first day before the last day of the part.

seasons.error.part_outside.text: The part must be inside the season's dates.

seasons.error.parts_overlap.text: Part 2 must start after part 1 ends.

seasons.error.coach_role_missing.text: Only members with the coach role can be assigned as coaches.

seasons.error.coach_not_found.text: This coach is no longer assigned.
